mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tags (user_id, name, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tags SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.name, t.created_at FROM tags t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.name

SELECT t.name, COUNT(dt.id) as count FROM tags t LEFT JOIN diary_tags dt ON t.id = dt.tag_id LEFT JOIN diaries d ON dt.diary_id = d.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY count DESC, t.name
